description: Search Spotify — canonical spotify: URIs, explicit, fetchedAt (flat 2 credits). Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 50). Flat 2 credits per call.

raw.description: Include per-result upstream payload as results[].raw. Default false. Pathfinder GraphQL vs Apify scraper shapes differ — see FAQ.

type.description: Result kind: tracks (default), albums, artists, podcasts, or episodes.

name: spotify_search
title: Spotify Search
